subject: {Invitation}  Encord's AI Leaders Roundtable in Paris
text:
Hi [NAME],​

Our Head of AI will be hosting an intimate dinner with customers & AI leaders and we would like to invite you. 

Attendees range from Directors of Computer Vision & VPs of AI from larger orgs like AXA, Sanofi, etc as well as CEO's & CTO's of leading VC-backed start-ups such as Deepomatic, Scortex, etc

This intimate dinner will take place on 21st of May at the Maison de L'Amérique Latine restaurant where we have secured a private dining room for ~20 people, starting at 7pm. 

In case you're not familiar with Encord, we raised $50M from CRV/YC and are an end-end data development platform for ML teams from Axa, EuroControl, Moon Surgical, etc. We are consolidating data management, visualisation, and annotation, solution all under one platform. 

Please RSVP to this invite should you wish to secure a spot on the dinner, spots are limited and on a first come, first served basis.

subject: Scaling ImgAssist AI 2.0
text:
Hi [NAME]​,

I've been following Perimeter Medical's recent growth and the launch of your B-Series OCT - thought it was a good time to reach out and reconnect. 

Believe your team spoke with [SENDER] @ Encord last year, and we've since grown rapidly in the medical imaging space (working with folks like asensus, Orsi Academy, Iterative Health etc.) helping them with their traceability regulatory requirements, time -saving on their file sharing and scaling annotation ops - imagine that is becoming a priority for yourselves. 

Would you be up for a 20 min chat and to reconnect? - would be great to trade notes and share what we're seeing in the space. Tuesdays/Thursdays work best for us.

subject: Expanding use cases of Ezra AI's full-body MRI platform
text:
Hi [NAME]​,

With Ezra AI's recent acquisition and broadening the platform's potential for diagnostic care, I thought I'd reach out.

I've recently been working with Prenuvo and Viz.ai when scaling annotation workflows and maintaining clinical-grade quality across datasets became a challenge. We helped as they refined cancer lesion segmentation models to improve segmentation precision and diagnostic reliability with DICOM-native annotation and validation tools.

Would be keen to trade notes and get your thoughts on what we're building - open to a 30-minute chat this or next week?

subject: AI Data Leaders Dinner Invite - London
text:
Hi [NAME],

Our CEO, [SENDER] is co-hosting an intimate gathering of Human Data Leaders with Prolific on Thursday, May 29th, and we'd love for you to join us, if you're available.

The event will run from 6:00 - 9:00 PM, and will include guests and experts from leading AI labs and companies including OpenAI, Cohere, Synthesia & Microsoft.

We'll kick off the evening with a panel discussion focused on the new frontiers of human data and best practices in building human-in-the-loop workflows. Following the panel, we'll move into a roundtable dinner with a more informal setting for the conversation to continue.

We are still finalizing the panel, and I was wondering if there was anyone from [COMPANY] on the data side that would be open to speaking on it? If so, please let me know and we can send an invite to them as well, and brief them on the night.

Please let me know if you're interested in participating and if anyone on the data team would be open to the panel.

subject: Working with Brainomix to improve stroke diagnostic accuracy of AI models
text:
Hi [NAME]​,

With your team's recent work in combining portable Ultra-Low-Field MRI with AI for improving access to care I thought I'd reach out. 

I've recently been working with Brainomix and Viz.ai working on lesion segmentation models to improve segmentation precision and diagnostic reliability with NIfTI-native annotation and validation tools. 

Saw your team will be at ASNR25. Would be keen to trade notes and get your thoughts on what we're building - open to a 30-minute chat this or next week?

subject: [Invitation] Dîner Leaders IA à Paris
text:
Bonjour [NAME]​, 

Notre co-fondateur organise un dîner intime avec des clients et des leaders de l'IA à Paris, et nous serions ravis de vous y inviter.

Les participants sont des CEO, CTO, Directeurs de Computer Vision et VP IA de start-ups comme Jellysmack, ProovStation, Veesion, etc. Ce dîner privé aura lieu le 21 mai au restaurant Maison de l'Amérique Latine, où nous avons réservé un salon privatisé pour environ 20 personnes, à partir de 19h.

Si vous ne connaissez pas encore Encord, nous avons levé 50M$ auprès de CRV et Y Combinator. Nous proposons une plateforme de développement de données end-to-end pour les équipes ML/IA, utilisée notamment par Axa, EuroControl, Moon Surgical, etc. Nous unifions la gestion des données, leur visualisation et leur annotation au sein d'une seule et même solution.

Merci de bien vouloir confirmer votre présence à cette invitation si vous souhaitez réserver votre place - les places sont limitées et attribuées selon le principe du premier arrivé, premier servi.
